recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Any future expansion to a fuller ISO 21298 vocabulary should be handled as a new Security/Terminology work-group and licensing decision, because current applied decisions intentionally use sample derived structural-role codes as an example binding.
issue_request: FHIR-12941 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked that the Security Role vocabulary/value set include role vocabulary defined in ISO 21298, while noting uncertainty about whether the whole or partial ISO vocabulary could legally be pulled into FHIR. Jira comments say Vocabulary/Grahame handled the ISO details and that the work had already been done after discussion.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-12941 source commit was found. The source history shows a SecurityRoleType value set added shortly before the Jira issue was filed, followed by Security WG maintenance. The current explicit ISO-21298-derived structural-role sample vocabulary was introduced through the later FHIR-32520 application and subsequent terminology cleanup commits.
additional_context: Later Security WG decisions narrowed the modern role model rather than importing the full ISO vocabulary. FHIR-32520 directs SecurityRoleType to be an example structural-role value set with sample codes derived from ISO-21298. FHIR-28184, FHIR-53882, and FHIR-55889 clarify agent.type versus agent.role and preserve the separation between participation/function roles and security/structural roles. The original Zulip discussion confirms copyright concerns around direct ISO content, and Confluence searches found no seed-specific conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source includes valueset-security-role-type-example, whose description and copyright identify ISO-21298-derived sample structural-role content; the included security-structural-roles-example CodeSystem is actively registered in source/fhir.ini; and AuditEvent.agent.role and Provenance.agent.role bind to that value set.

related_jiras.note: Republished SecurityRoleType as an example structural-role value set with sample codes derived from ISO-21298, defining the current intended scope.
Clarified Provenance.agent.type versus Provenance.agent.role and anchored agent.role to structural/security roles with ISO 21298 context.
Clarified AuditEvent.agent.type and agent.role while retaining ISO 21298 as role-model context rather than a complete vocabulary import.
Removed extra-security-role-type from the participation role type value set, preserving the separation between participation/function and security/structural roles.
